events.verdict: Turner (IND) releases from Suggs (ORL) during the rebound and the contact is marginal.
Suggs (ORL) drives into Nembhard (IND), but not through his space and he does not dislodge him from his defensive position.
Turner (IND) and Caldwell-Pope (ORL) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and incidental leg to leg contact occurs during the rebound.
Suggs (ORL) straddles the lane line and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Caldwell-Pope (ORL) leans forwards to brace for the ensuing contact with Siakam (IND) in the post and the contact is marginal.
Isaac (ORL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Siakam (IND) reaches for the loose ball and the contact with Caldwell-Pope's (ORL) arm is marginal.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of a defensive goaltending by Turner (IND) is confirmed. Turner makes contact with Wagner's (ORL) shot attempt after it hits the backboard with a chance to score.
Siakam (IND) and Isaac (ORL) engage and disengage and both players are able to move freely off ball.
Black (ORL) reaches at the ball and makes more-than-marginal contact with Siakam's (IND) left arm.
Wagner (ORL) commits a take foul on Mathurin (IND).
Mathurin (IND) makes clean contact with the ball during Suggs' (ORL) drive.

events.verdict: Suggs (ORL) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
